item.title: Comment on Friday assorted links by Steven
item.description:
9. I don't believe this. People do not make strategies this far ahead. Here is what I think has happened:

Elon did indeed have initially a strategy to save civilization through electric cars and space travel. Somewhere along the way, his daughter became trans, which really annoyed him and he saw it as a dangerous ideology (I agree). He started to become more political, annoyed his allies on the left, and took over twitter, which annoyed them even more. As he descended deeper into becoming a twitter troll, his obsession with politics grew. Now, he is an accountant wasting his life mucking about with ultimately meaningless changes in a huge bureaucracy which he doesn't really understand. He has forsaken his noble goals, because he has become infected by social media with the same political mind virus that affects so much of modern American society.
